TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Si-æugh ki anna ni-akoumea ki 'Ouvavatoug-han ki Jo-den, ka ni-sa-bavau ta ti Jesus mou-qua tou Jerusalem.
S.TRANSL: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
這事以後，到了猶太人的一個節期，耶穌就上耶路撒冷去。

S.FORM: Ka akoumea hynna tou Je-rusalem itoutouk [ki ngataf] ki i-ouko ta æ̈iæu'ug-han ka ra-loum ka siouä tou sou ki He-breen Bethesda, ka na rymmato ki sau-lan ka laf.
S.TRANSL: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
在耶路撒冷，靠近羊門有一個池子，希伯來話叫作畢士大，旁邊有五個廊子；

S.FORM: Ka ni-malikou hynna ta ka-batoung-an ka irang ka maälam, ka mavoutta, ka mapyllei, ka yhgou yl-lan tou 'amamat-ten ki k'yllykkalykka-eih ki raloum.
S.TRANSL: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
裏面躺着瞎眼的、瘸腿的、血氣枯乾的許多病人。

S.FORM: . Ka Tama Gnau ta ni-mou-rarim tou sasasat ki kidi tou 'æ̈i-æug-han tmyvo ki raloum: anna ta ti-mamang ta nisi-ouro hynna mou-rbo rou t'yvou-an-nato ta raloum ni-kæuh d'arijkkagh ta teni, mou-kouna rou kamamang lava ta maälam tyn.
S.TRANSL: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

S.FORM: Ka ni-akoumea hynna saät ki voual ka makka touro kyttiæn æb ki kæu-'yhpa ki tauwil ki ni-kaälam-men tyn.
S.TRANSL: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
在那裏有一個人，病了三十八年。

S.FORM: Irou ka kmytta ta ti Jesus ty-ni-æn ka malykko, ka kavan-nan tyn ka makka dalli-ato ki ni kaälam-men tyn, ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Mamoei kow kaua madarijk-kagh?
S.TRANSL: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
耶穌看見他躺着，知道他病了許久，就問他說：「你要痊癒嗎？」

S.FORM: Ni-matte'i-vli tyni-æn ta maälam, Meirang, äoussi jau-an saät ki voual ka smaki-qua jau-an tou æ̈iæuug-han rou pati-voe-en ta raloum: ka rou 'ou-koun-ato-mau, mou-rarim ta pani si-ouro jau-an.
S.TRANSL: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
病人回答說：「先生，水動的時候，沒有人把我放在池子裏；我正去的時候，就有別人比我先下去。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Æhpit-â, 'angpô-au ta 'ææpag-en-hou ka mou-naunang-â.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
耶穌對他說：「起來，拿你的褥子走吧！」

S.FORM: Ka madijs madarijkkag-ato ta voël kanna, ka ni-angpo-in tyn ta ææ̈pag-hin tyn mou-naunang. Ka kidi ki pæ'i-hababan ta wæ'i kanna.
S.TRANSL: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
那人立刻痊癒，就拿起褥子來走了。

S.FORM: Annata ni-k'ma ta Joden tyni-æn; ka pa-darikkag-en-ato, Wæ'i-ato ki pæ'i-hababan, assi hahei-en ymhou-an mangpo ma-val ki 'ææ̈paghin.
S.TRANSL: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
那天是安息日，所以猶太人對那醫好的人說：「今天是安息日，你拿褥子是不可的。」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta teni nei-ni-æn; Teni ka ni-pa-darijkkag, jau-an, teni ta ni-k'ma jau-an, 'Angpo-au ta ææ̈pag-en-hou, mou-naunang-â.
S.TRANSL: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
他卻回答說：「那使我痊癒的，對我說：『拿你的褥子走吧。』」

S.FORM: Annata ni-tmalig ta neni tyni-æn; Ti-mang ta vouel k'anna ka ni-k'ma ymhou-an, 'Angpo au ta ææ̈pag-en-hou, mou-naunang-â?
S.TRANSL: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
他們問他說：「對你說『拿褥子走』的是甚麼人？」

S.FORM: Ka teni ka ni-pa-darykkag-en, assi mou-mhga ka ti-mang ta teni: Ka ni-mou-zoug d'marang ta ti Jesus, alei ka æ'iaqua hynna ki makoi-lalaulau tou itou-qu'an kanna.
S.TRANSL: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
那醫好的人不知道是誰；因為那裏的人多，耶穌已經躲開了。

S.FORM: Siæ̈ugh ki anna ni-kabalei-en ta teni ti Jesus tou Kouva ki t'a-t'am'd-den ki Alid, ka ni-kma ty-ni-æn, K'yttei ni-padarikag-en kow, ynna mela mavarau, kou assi-ah kow masaoun ma't-'æ̈ rou-rouman.
S.TRANSL: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
後來耶穌在殿裏遇見他，對他說：「你已經痊癒了，不要再犯罪，恐怕你遭遇的更加利害。」

S.FORM: Ni-d'marang ta vouël k'an-na, ka ni-hnau-en tyn vanavana ki Joden, ka ti Jesus ta ni-pa-daryk-kagh tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
那人就去告訴猶太人，使他痊癒的是耶穌。

S.FORM: Alei ki anna ni-kmou-d'yl-loug ta Joden ti Jesus-an, kma-ki'ym ki paka-patei-an-ei tyni-æn, alei ka pa-amt-ten tyn ta anna tou wæ'i ki pæ'i-habab-an.
S.TRANSL: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
所以猶太人逼迫耶穌，因為他在安息日做了這事。

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Mapoungas ta Rama-au tou kidi hnyn, ka mapoungas [appa]-koh ti jau.
S.TRANSL: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
耶穌就對他們說：「我父做事直到如今，我也做事。」

S.FORM: Alei ki anna ni-maki-saoun kmi-'ym ta Joden ki paka-patei-an-ei tyni-æn, alei ka assi dyk sidad'an tyn ta wæ'i ki pæ'i-habab'-an, ra ni-k'ma-appa, ka Alid ta Ra-rama-an tyn ka dilligh, ka pæ-pæh kaulaul-'an tyn tyni-æn mamado ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
所以猶太人越發想要殺他；因他不但犯了安息日，並且稱上帝為他的父，將自己和上帝當作平等。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus, k'ma neini-æn; Missing, missing koun-nau-kamou, Assi pa-yl-pough ta Alak sikounnoung pæ'-mado pæ-pamut ki mamang, rou assi tyn k'yt-tan ta anna pamut ki Rama: ka kamamang ka p'am't-ten tyn, att'-appa ta p'am't-ten ki Alak.
S.TRANSL: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
耶穌對他們說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，子憑着自己不能做甚麼，惟有看見父所做的，子才能做；父所做的事，子也照樣做。

S.FORM: Ka mævæængö ta Rama ki Alak ka pa-kytta tyni-æn ki mamang ka pei-ringei-en tyn: Ka pa-kytta-âl-appa tyni-æn ki pei-rin-gei-en ka masaoung irang ki atta, alei ka mouringhga-ah-kamou.
S.TRANSL: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
父愛子，將自己所做的一切事指給他看，還要將比這更大的事指給他看，叫你們希奇。

S.FORM: Ka mama ka pa-æhpit pa-kæuagh ta Rama ki patei, pa-kæu-agh-appa kma-hynna ta Alak ti mamang-an ka kamoei-en tyn.
S.TRANSL: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
父怎樣叫死人起來，使他們活着，子也照樣隨自己的意思使人活着。

S.FORM: Ka assi dmungdung ti-ma-mang-an ta Rama, râ ni-pææ-ymdden tyn ta dungdung-en pi'æ̈ ki Alak.
S.TRANSL: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
父不審判甚麼人，乃將審判的事全交與子，

S.FORM: Alei ka ym'd-dah ta neni loumoulough ki Alak, mama ki louloug-en nein ki Rama. Ti-ma-mang ta assi loumoulough ki A-lak, assi loumoulough ki Rama ka ni-madingi tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
叫人都尊敬子如同尊敬父一樣。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬差子來的父。

S.FORM: Missing, missing koun-nau-kamou, Ti-mamang ta mil-lingigh ki sou-au ka tna-msing ty-ni-æn ka ni-madingi jau-an, akou-mea ta teni ki kæuag-han ka myh-kaqua myddarym-ough, ka assi tyn 'ou-koun tou pahkou-ava-vag-han: ra ni-sah-tounnoun ta teni tou kapatei-an sah-kaqua tou kæuag-han.
S.TRANSL: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
我實實在在地告訴你們，那聽我話、又信差我來者的，就有永生；不至於定罪，是已經出死入生了。

S.FORM: Missing, missing koun-nau-kamou, Iroua ta [kidi ki] tæ-lei, ka annaun hnyn, ka millin-gigh-ah ta patei ki yngau ki Alak ki Alid, ka na mamang ta millin-gigh-âl-ato, mæuag-al ta neni.
S.TRANSL: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
我實實在在地告訴你們，時候將到，現在就是了，死人要聽見上帝兒子的聲音，聽見的人就要活了。

S.FORM: Ka mama ka akou kæuag-an ta Rama tyni-æn mamado, ni-phæn-appa tyn kma-hynna ki Alak ka akou kæuag-han ta teny tyni-æn mamado.
S.TRANSL: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
因為父怎樣在自己有生命，就賜給他兒子也照樣在自己有生命，

S.FORM: Ka ni-phæn tyn ta keirang-an ki kidi tyni-æn tou paam't-tin appa ki dingding-en, alei ka Alak ta teni ki kaæulong.
S.TRANSL: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
並且因為他是人子，就賜給他行審判的權柄。

S.FORM: Ynnâ mou-rynhgau ki an-na: nda iroua ta [kidi ki] tælei ka tna-ymd-dah millingigh ki yngau tyn ta æ'iarbo ki ravaravak.
S.TRANSL: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
你們不要把這事看作希奇。時候要到，凡在墳墓裏的，都要聽見他的聲音，就出來：

S.FORM: Ka mou-pænæ'-ah, ta ni-mapoungas ki mariang, tou lykkoug-eih æhpit ka tou kæuæg-han: ne-ni-appa ka ni-mapoungas ki assi mariang, tou lykkoug-ei æhpit ka tou pahkou-avavag-hen.
S.TRANSL: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
行善的，復活得生；作惡的，復活定罪。

S.FORM: Assi-koh pa-ylpough syk-kounoung pamut ki mamang. Mama ki illing'-h-en-nau dmung-dung koh: ka matiktik ta ding-ding-en-nau, ka assi-koh kmi-ym ki kamoei-en-nau, râ ka-moei-in appa ki Rama ka ni-ma-dingi jau-an.
S.TRANSL: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
「我憑着自己不能做甚麼，我怎麼聽見就怎麼審判。我的審判也是公平的；因為我不求自己的意思，只求那差我來者的意思。」

S.FORM: Heirou mattæ'i-hail-koh mattæ'i-mymmia jau-an mattæ'i-madô, assi matiktik ta pattæ'i-hail-en-nau.
S.TRANSL: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
「我若為自己作見證，我的見證就不真。

S.FORM: Akoumea ki pani ka mat-tæ'i-hail mattæ'i-mymmia jau-an, ka kavana-en-nau ka matik-tik ta pattæ'i-hail-len tyn mattæ'i-mymmia jau-an.
S.TRANSL: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
另有一位給我作見證，我也知道他給我作的見證是真的。

S.FORM: Emoumi ta ni-madingi pa-ou-koua ti Joannes-an, ka ni-pat-tæ'ihail-len tyn ki katiktik-an ki sou.
S.TRANSL: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
你們曾差人到約翰那裏，他為真理作過見證。

S.FORM: Ra ti jau assi-koh tama-mymmia ki pattæ'ihaillen ki ka-æuloung: ra att'-appa ta ka sou-en-nau alei ka pakariang-eil-ato-kamou.
S.TRANSL: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
其實，我所受的見證不是從人來的；然而，我說這些話，為要叫你們得救。

S.FORM: Na æuyng ta teni ka myl-lamæh ka mææu-yng: ka ni-ma-moei-kamou marei assi madallia ki kidi tou ræmæh tyn.
S.TRANSL: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
約翰是點着的明燈，你們情願暫時喜歡他的光。

S.FORM: Ra akoumea koh ki pattæ-'i-hail-len ka masaoung irang ka a ti Joannes. Ka ringhi ka ni-phæn ki Rama jau-an tou pam't-ei-mau ki anna, ringei ka pa-am't-en-nau mattæ'i-hail mattæ'i-mymmia jau-an, ka ni-padingi-en koh ki Rama.
S.TRANSL: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
但我有比約翰更大的見證；因為父交給我要我成就的事，就是我所做的事，這便見證我是父所差來的。

S.FORM: Ka Rama ka ni-madingi jau-an ni-mattæ'i-mado mattæ'i-hail mattæ'i-mymmia jau-an myh-kakoua. Assi-kamou ni-millingigh ki yngau tyn, ka assi-kamou ni-kmytta ki hauwei tyn.
S.TRANSL: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
差我來的父也為我作過見證。你們從來沒有聽見他的聲音，也沒有看見他的形像。

S.FORM: Ka assi mæylli ymoumi-æn ta sou tyn: alei ka assi-kamou tna-msing tyni-æn ka ni-padingi-en tyn.
S.TRANSL: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
你們並沒有他的道存在心裏；因為他所差來的，你們不信。

S.FORM: Maki-riang-â kmiym ki na sasoulat: ka pæ-hdimdim-kamou ki paki-valei-ei-moumi tou atta ki kæuag-han ka myhkakoua myd-daryn-nough: anna ta mattæ'i-hail mattæ'i-mimia jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
你們查考聖經，因你們以為內中有永生；給我作見證的就是這經。

S.FORM: Ka ynnang-kamou mou-koua jau-an, alei ka akoume'ah-kamou ki kæuag-han.
S.TRANSL: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
然而，你們不肯到我這裏來得生命。

S.FORM: Assi-koh tama-mymmia ki keirang-an ki kidi tou kaæu-loung-ang.
S.TRANSL: I receive not honour from men.
「我不受從人來的榮耀。

S.FORM: Ra k'alang-en-nau-kamou, ka aoussi-[kamou] ymoumi-æn ki kavæangö-an ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
但我知道，你們心裏沒有上帝的愛。

S.FORM: Irou-ato-koh tou Na-nang ki Rama-au, ka assi-kamou matta-ryh jau-an: irou-ra iro'al-lato ta pani [ki vouël] tou nanang tyn mamado, teni ta atta-ryh-ei-moumi.
S.TRANSL: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
我奉我父的名來，你們並不接待我；若有別人奉自己的名來，你們倒要接待他。

S.FORM: Tna-lpough-kamou tna-msing mama ki mang ka paki-tæ-væh-noumi maki-mymmia ki lou-loug-an, ka louloug-an k'anna ka makka-dyk makka-koua ki Alid, assi-moumi kiym-men?
S.TRANSL: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
你們互相受榮耀，卻不求從獨一之上帝來的榮耀，怎能信我呢？

S.FORM: Ynna pæh-dimdim, ka mattæ'i-vavoulas-ah-koh mattæ'i doum-ma-doumm'a ymoumi-æn ki Rama: ki mattæ'i-vavou-las mattæ'i-doumma-doumma ymoumi-æn teni-ato ta ti Moses, ka hydtaddug-'n-noumi.
S.TRANSL: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
不要想我在父面前要告你們；有一位告你們的，就是你們所仰賴的摩西。

S.FORM: Ka rou tna-msing-kamou ti Moses-an, ynna-kamou tna-msing jau-an. Ka ni-soulat-ten tyn mææ-koua jau-an.
S.TRANSL: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me; for he wrote of me.
你們如果信摩西，也必信我，因為他書上有指着我寫的話。

S.FORM: Irou-ra assi-kamou tna-msing ki na sasoulat tyn, tna-msing-ah-kamou mama ki mang ki sou-au?
S.TRANSL: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
你們若不信他的書，怎能信我的話呢？」
